answer: A fake identity farm would need to replicate unique credentials, not just wallets, driving attacker cost from near zero to real per-identity expense. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent bonds a unique proof-of-personhood credential to its wallet, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Like a canyon that narrows to one pass, the gate admits only bonded identities; a single ember of trust cannot ignite a spiral of clones, because unattested sybils earn nothing and their bonds are slashed on detection.
